out: ⏰ **Deadline passed: First sitting of the Lamplit Council** (day 13 12:00) — the eighteen lamps sit for the first time. Make it happen, then `./dm clock done k1`.
verdict_notes: UNCLEAR, recommend accept. Mechanics: HP 51 to 55 (max), no Hit Dice or resources were spent, so the only benefit was +4 HP. Time: the engine's +8h on the rest was a double count, because 22:00 to 06:00 was already slept (8h, at least 6h sleep, no strenuous activity narrated); the reset to day 13 06:00, stopping k1 and adding k4 for noon is the right fix and the narration (woke 06:00, scalds gone) matches. 24h limit (PHB p.186, a character cannot benefit from more than one long rest in a 24-hour period): the day 12 rest ran dawn 06:00 to 14:00 and this one ran 22:00 to 06:00, so it began 16h after the first and finished 16h after it. The gate counted from the previous start (exactly 24h). RAW does not say whether the 24h runs from start or from end, and the stricter end-to-end reading would make this rest not count. Only 4 HP rides on it, so I accept it. For future rests: space them 24h apart, finish to finish, to be safe.
